relevance_note: Postmortem case report of one person with Danon disease ("a 25‐year‐old male with no history of transplantation who succumbed to heart failure secondary to DD"), plus one previously published patient (Hong et al. [12]) described with individual features.
method_note: Hand extraction; a short script only assembled the JSON and checked spans. No LAMP2 variant is printed or tied to either person (diagnosis of the donor is per body donation documentation/death certificate; no genetic testing is reported), so the variants table is empty. Label 'patient' = the single body donor (rule 5; 'donor' is a role word). 'ref [12] patient' = the DD patient of Hong et al. [12], in scope because features are given (muscle weakness after heart transplant, elevated CK); the CK/methylprednisolone sentence is cited to [13, 14] although the patient is attributed to Hong et al. [12] (possible citation inconsistency). The seven RP-A501 Phase I patients are group-level only and get no rows. Age at last evaluation and age at death both taken from '25‐year‐old' (postmortem report). Right ventricular hypertrophy marked observed from 'biventricular hypertrophy'. 'Ocular dysfunction' is stated without detail, so the retinopathy checklist item stays not reported. Internal arithmetic inconsistency: LV wall 2.1 cm vs average 8.7 mm is stated as '2313.7% thicker', and circumference 29.2 cm vs 9 cm as '224.4% larger'; the measured values were used, not the percentages. Figures 2-6 legends describe the donor's heart tissue (tissue samples were collected from the donor's heart). Supplementary file is the CARE checklist only.
